profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with extensive experience across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architecture design through implementation, production deployment, and post-launch iteration.
 
Specializes in building and extending mission-critical distributed systems in complex enterprise environments, with end-to-end ownership of key features and system integrations, serving as a technical reference for complex domain-specific challenges.
 
Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI agents in production environments, including LLM-powered tools for operational automation.
 
Committed to delivering high-quality, low-defect solutions with minimal post-launch rework, and to supporting team growth through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer and subject matter expert for the Material Flow System (MFS), Tesla's mission-critical platform for real-time inventory control and material logistics, with end-to-end ownership of key features and integrations. MFS is deployed across Gigafactories, warehouses, and service/distribution centers in North America, EMEA, and APAC.

• Led end-to-end design and delivery of distributed inventory orchestration solutions supporting manufacturing continuity, automated storage and retrieval, demand replenishment, and global supply chain fulfillment.
• Designed and implemented event-driven integrations using Kafka, REST APIs, and SOAP/WCF services between Factory Execution, Logistics, Finance, and Manufacturing Execution systems, as well as warehouse automation platforms and external supplier systems.
• Coordinates release preparation activities and built automation tooling to eliminate manual overhead in DB migration consolidation, change request generation, and deployment coordination across multiple environments.
• Participates in production incident bridge calls as technical reference for MFS key features, investigating root causes and implementing fixes to restore normal workflow across production and service teams.
• Travels on-site when needed to support critical production deployments, including cases where production trials are conducted directly in live environments with no lower-environment equivalent available.
• Mentors new team members on system architecture, codebase structure, and development workflows, and conducts regular code reviews across the team.

Key projects include VSRS automated storage integration, Battery & Cell line MES integration, Dynamic Min/Max demand optimization, Cycle-Based Orders, Operational Centers core flows implementation, and AI agent development for production operations — see Projects section for full detail.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Led a team of 10 engineers building a greenfield financial platform from scratch — initiated as a configurable credit origination and loan management system for a teachers' union, and expanded over 4 years into a full digital banking ecosystem with card issuance, online banking, and payment services for customers in Mexico and the US.
* Designed and built a configurable multi-step workflow engine for end-to-end credit origination — covering loan application, document scanning and upload, multi-level review, committee approval, fund transfer to the customer, and ongoing loan lifecycle management including payment receipts, balance calculations, and loan settlement.
* Implemented and configured a third-party card processing system, working directly with the vendor through full setup, configuration, and testing. Integrated the platform with Carnet, Mexico's domestic payment card network, to enable live transaction processing on the banking authorization network.
* Built an online banking platform allowing customers to activate cards, view balances, and initiate money transfers to any Mexican bank account via CLABE interbank routing. Integrated SMS notifications for real-time transaction and approval alerts.
* Extended the platform with bill payment integrations for utility and telecom services in Mexico, and integrated with a US-based bill payment provider enabling cross-border bill payment capabilities for customers with financial needs in both Mexico and the US.
* Designed and developed Web APIs enabling business partner integrations with the platform's financial services. Owned full-stack architecture across all products: application layer, web services, and database design.
* Led hiring, performance assessment, and mentoring of the engineering team, and established development methodologies and best practices.

projects.title: AI Agent — Production Control Supervisor
projects.description:
Contributed to the Manufacturing AI team's agent platform — a suite of AI agents built around MFS user personas. Designed and implemented in Python the configuration validation feature for the Production Control Supervisor Agent (PCSA).

The agent audits inventory flow configurations per Gigafactory — with capacity to process 10,000+ configurations and ~2,500 currently enabled — verifying that all required steps are correctly set up across multi-location material flows from external suppliers to production lines. Each flow represents a series of configured steps that MFS must have in place for inventory to move through locations such as supplier yards, docks, intermediate storage, and production lines.

Supports both broad validation prompts and part-specific queries, returning detailed gap analysis identifying which steps are missing or misconfigured. Capable of answering follow-up questions about the validation results. Deployed in production across multiple Gigafactories.

projects.title: Dynamic Min/Max — Inventory Demand Optimization
projects.description:
• For certain production lines, static inventory min/max configurations can result in unnecessary stock buildup and floor space consumption regardless of actual upcoming production demand. Extended the existing demand-based inventory optimization to address this by integrating with the production plan to support configurable demand projections driven either by a lead time window or a fixed vehicle count, making replenishment calculations dynamic and forward-looking for those lines.

• Enhanced the production plan integration with the Factory Execution System to calculate forward-looking material demand based on a configurable lead time window, determining how much inventory needs to be replenished in advance to meet upcoming production demand.

• Extended the order management logic to support automatic cancellation of excess replenishment orders when inventory projections indicate more stock than needed, complemented by production sequence validation to avoid generating unnecessary orders, inventory allocation and picking flows restricted to specific container types, and extensions to the Demand Counter Adjustment to prevent conflicts with this planning process.
